title: Close vectorizer recovery-retirement workstream as retained research-only lineage
intent: Reconcile the already-executed Tier A relocation of cognitive/grid/Phase-2 lineage into vectorizer-sandbox, preserve benchmark and forensic evidence, correct stale governance contradictions, and pin the existing production re-import gate. Current production vectorizer behavior remains unchanged.
behavior_change: No production runtime behavior change. No vectorizer algorithm, router, default UI mode, DXF output, IBG intake, CAM authority, or manufacturing output change. Governance now records RETAIN_RESEARCH_ONLY for the relocated Tier A lineage and classifies CleanupMode.ENHANCED as API-exposed experimental/SANDBOX authority rather than production-qualified.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Lifecycle/canonical-path/capability/debt documents were reconciled with the relocation that already happened in May 2026; VEC-ROOT-001 gains a provenance erratum for body_lexicon.md; a closeout record and preservation inventory were added; a lightweight integrity test pins the boundary.
diff_articulation.why: The repository still contained stale statements that Tier A migration was merely proposed, local paths that had already been removed, a false claim that body_lexicon.md had never been committed, and conflicting governance labels for CleanupMode.ENHANCED.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The existing check_semantic_sandbox_imports.py already enforces the production import boundary, so this patch intentionally does not add a duplicate freeze checker. The new test only pins the accepted lifecycle/document state and existing gate.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: services/api/app/, services/photo-vectorizer runtime code, services/blueprint-import runtime code, hostinger/blueprint-reader.html, vectorizer algorithms, test_text_masking_regression.py, Cuatro artifacts, Melody Maker fixture, and the vectorizer-regression workflow.

Verified scripts/governance/check_semantic_sandbox_imports.py already owns the no-reimport gate and is included in scripts/governance/check_all.py and tests/test_governance_compliance.py.
Verified current blueprint router accepts explicit CleanupMode values while default remains refined; no router/runtime edit is made.
PR CI will run repository governance and focused integrity tests.
